component.name: Huginn
component.summary: A controller-first file explorer for SteamOS Game Mode

description.p: Huginn is a file explorer built for handhelds and the couch. Every action works from a controller, text is typed with Steam's own keyboard, and the layout grows for a TV when docked.

ul.li: Two panes, an action wheel, and trash with undo
Steam folders shown by game name, with saves, Proton prefix and shader cache in one place
Phone transfer over your home network with a QR code and PIN
Ventoy install and update, image writing and USB formatting
Archive browsing and extraction, image and text previews, network shares
